mechanism: Tretinoin (especially systemic isotretinoin) is teratogenic and candesartan is an ARB with teratogenic potential; concurrent use increases fetal risk if pregnancy occurs, and tretinoin may potentiate hyperkalemia risk from candesartan.
action: Avoid concurrent use in women of childbearing potential; if necessary, ensure reliable contraception with tretinoin and consider alternative antihypertensive; monitor potassium levels as both agents can elevate K+.
